scope: External electrical/AMI mechanism validation only. No entry supplies streetlight field accuracy, streetlight fault recall, or fault probability.

records.domain: Smart-grid substation; actual deployed three-phase four-wire AMI smart meters
records.label_type: Seven-class metering anomaly classification: 0 normal, 1-6 opaque Abnormal-1 through Abnormal-6
records.label_source: Repository claims 122 meters were manually inspected on-site or professionally labelled; 382 are normal
records.sampling_interval: 30 minutes; 48 points per daily sample according to current repository README
records.eligibility: Released only as External MAD author-split sample-level binary 0-vs-1..6; EXTERNAL_GOLD_OR_PROFESSIONAL_LABEL for smart-grid metering anomalies only
evidence_gaps: Current repository release has no DOI and uses opaque abnormal classes.
Associated 2024 primary paper reports 15-minute/96-point, 7421-sample data and named classes; it is not release-equivalent to the current repository README.
Author split construction, meter IDs, timestamps, meter-to-sample mapping, and meter-disjointness are UNKNOWN; Track B is NOT_ASSESSABLE.
records.exclusion_reason: No exclusion for narrow Track A. Track B and all class-mechanism claims are excluded because physical-meter leakage cannot be assessed. CC BY-ND 4.0 forbids sharing adapted material; raw and transformed data stay out of Git.
records.claim_boundary: Track A results are External MAD author-split sample-level binary 0-vs-1..6 performance, not meter-disjoint performance, streetlight field accuracy, streetlight fault recall, class mechanism evidence, or fault probability.

records.domain: UK domestic electrical appliance load; REFIT aggregate and submetered measurements
records.measurement_type: Real electrical load measurements with appliance-level anomaly annotations
records.label_type: Annotated real appliance anomaly windows; exact operational rule and counts pending primary README/paper verification
records.label_source: Human-annotated by sifting REFIT data; official dataset record delegates labelling rules to ICASSP 2019 paper

train/test.recommended_unit: house-disjoint or time-forward, selected before test labels

records.eligibility: Potential secondary mechanism validation for LG-S1 baseline deviation and LG-S2 persistence only
evidence_gaps: Exact annotation rule, label-window semantics, and counts are not independently verified because the linked README/manuscript endpoint was access-restricted during review.
No three-phase current channels; LG-S3 phase asymmetry is unavailable.
records.raw_availability: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA: official file download returned 403 repeatedly
records.exclusion_reason: GATED: resolve BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA, acquire and freeze exact label-rule documentation and a pre-test split. Domestic appliance outcomes are not streetlight or cabinet fault labels.
records.claim_boundary: If included, report only External REFIT real-load anomaly mechanism results. Do not infer streetlight fault performance.

records.domain: UCR Time Series Anomaly Archive generic univariate temporal anomaly benchmark with Italianpowerdemand sequences
records.label_type: Anomaly interval boundaries encoded in official filenames after the train-end position
records.label_source: Official UCR Anomaly Archive file naming convention

train/test.status: author-provided train endpoint and anomaly interval boundary in filename

records.eligibility: Optional secondary temporal stress test only after explicit licence verification
evidence_gaps: No dataset-specific explicit licence verified in reviewed official UCR Anomaly Archive material.
No verified electrical anomaly/fault physical cause, phase channel, meter identity, or field outcome.
No phase, meter, or streetlight operational information.
records.exclusion_reason: Licence UNKNOWN gates secondary execution. Even if licensed, exclude from external electrical mechanism accuracy, phase claims, Gold/professional labels, and fault claims.
records.claim_boundary: Temporal anomaly stress-test performance, if permitted, is not electrical mechanism validity and never streetlight performance.

records.domain: Hourly smart-meter electricity consumption from ENFIELD infrastructure
records.label_source: XGBoost and LightGBM ensemble trained on LEAD data from 200 buildings

train/test.status: no independent ground-truth split established for this task

records.eligibility: Weak-label stress test only if separately approved and licence verified
evidence_gaps: Record does not supply an explicit licence in reviewed metadata.
Labels are not independently observed field or professional truth.
Generating-model training data and validation leakage controls are outside this task's verified provenance.
